Contact Us

Roza Graphic Machinery For Used Printing Machines

Roza Graphic Machinery is a very trusted dealer of used printing equipment.

Roza Graphic Machinery, our in-house company, specializes in offset printing technologies.

Uses of Offset Printing

When we talk about offset printing, we talk about high quality with effective-cost at the same time.

As we know, offset printing is a process of printing that uses a metal plate to transfer

an image onto a rubber blanket, and then onto the surface to be printed.

Why offset printing

Offset printing is the most common form of printing. It is a much more effective and efficient process than digital printing.

It has been around for over 100 years, and it is still the most popular form of printing today.

One of the biggest pros is that it’s environmentally friendly.

content.rendered:
About RGM

Roza Graphic Machinery offers a complete range of used offset printing machinery from some of today’s most innovative manufacturers.

Also, we believe that trading a used offset printing machine is not just about business. It is about a long-lasting relationship with the client including advice and mutual trust.

Contact RGM

Our Story

Roza Graphic Machinery was established and has grown in a few years by a team of competent engineers with more than 10 years of experience. RGM has become one of the largest used offset printing machine providers in the Middle East.

Roza Graphic Machinery has been for years supplying the needs for used pre-press, used offset printing machines.

We have the full efficiency to provide all operations related to installation, dismantling, re-location logistics, and packing & shipping to all destinations.

We provide the best quality of products and services to our customers in Egypt & Gulf Countries.

Our services include:

📌 After-sales & Logistic Services
📌 Shipment to all destinations
📌 Installation throughout the world

 

We offer these services alongside the purchase of a printing machine, or separately.

 

Why Is RGM the Place for Used Offset Graphic Machines?

RGM provides the complete package for everything you need when thinking about used offset printing machines of high quality.

Be confident and relaxed with anything related to:

🔹Selling / Buying

🔹Passing by Transportation

🔹Installation

🔹Maintenance

🔹After-sales Services

 

All our machines are available for demonstration. We find it important to allow customers and potential customers to see them working in person.

Get Started

We Make from Used Offset Printing Machines the Right Combination for Your Needs.

Our used offset printing machines come in diverse sizes with different resolutions, speeds, and configurations to suit a variety of printing needs. Whether it be large or small-scale printing projects, we have what covers all.
We also offer a warranty on all purchases.

Quality Assurance

RGM team of experts offers after-sales service that covers machine installation, operation training, maintenance services and more. Your used offset printing machines are guaranteed a high level of quality as well as prompt customer service that considers your needs.

Expertise in After-sales

We are committed to providing our customers with the highest quality of service and support after the sale.
Besides that, we offer our clients our extensive experience in this field to achieve the highest level of efficiency.

Range of Quality Machinery

At RGM, you can find a used offset printing machine that best suits your printing requirements.

because of our expertise to achieve a balance between quality and price.

We offer several plans of payments and premium services.
